Demo Mastitis Dataset

Source: R/data.R
demo_mastitis.Rd

A synthetic dairy herd of 200 cows with mastitis labels applied at 15% prevalence. Built on top of demo_herd with mastitis disease effects applied. Suitable for binary classification exercises.

Usage

demo_mastitis

Format

A tibble with 200 rows and 14 columns. All columns from demo_herd plus:

temperature

Numeric. Body temperature in °C. Elevated in mastitis cases.

rumination_minutes

Integer. Daily rumination time in minutes. Reduced in mastitis cases.

mastitis

Logical. TRUE if the cow has mastitis. The classification target.

Source

Generated by VirtualDairyHerdR. See data-raw/generate_demo_data.R.

Details

Mastitis cases (approx. 15% of cows) have:

  • Milk yield reduced by 15–40%

  • SCC elevated 5–20x

  • Body temperature increased +0.5 to +2.5 °C

  • Rumination reduced by 20–50%

Generated with:

demo_mastitis <- simulate_mastitis(demo_herd, prevalence = 0.15, seed = 42)

Examples

data(demo_mastitis)
table(demo_mastitis$mastitis)
#> 
#> FALSE  TRUE 
#>    89    11 
education_summary(demo_mastitis, by = "breed")
#> # A tibble: 4 × 9
#>   breed    n_cows mean_dim mean_milk_kg sd_milk_kg mean_fat_pct mean_protein_pct
